name: integrations
title: Integrations
summary: Claude Code and Codex get the official GitHub, Context7, and Convex plugins, and Claude can hand work to Codex.
day: Agents read and change your GitHub issues and pull requests, look up current library docs before they write code, and inspect your Convex deployments. With both AI plans, Claude hands a task or a review to Codex.
cost: Each plugin signs in once on each machine, and fleet doctor says how: a GitHub token for Claude, Context7 through its own sign-in, and Convex through its CLI. Codex's GitHub and Convex plugins use your ChatGPT sign-in. Convex starts off.
risk: The plugins act with the accounts you sign in with. Fleet removes only plugins that it installed, and keeps a plugin you turn off in your settings off.

workflows.name: GitHub
workflows.sentence: Agents read and change issues and pull requests through GitHub's official plugin.

workflows.name: Context7
workflows.sentence: Agents look up current library documentation through Context7.

workflows.name: Convex
workflows.sentence: Agents get Convex guidance and inspect the deployment of the project they work in.

workflows.name: Codex from Claude
workflows.sentence: Claude Code hands a task, a diagnosis, or a review to Codex through OpenAI's Codex plugin.

checks.say: Claude's GitHub plugin cannot reach GitHub. It reads a token from GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the shell that starts Claude Code, so add export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)" to your shell profile, or export a fine-grained token there, then start a new shell. Fleet never stores the token.
Claude's Context7 plugin is not signed in. In Claude Code, run /mcp, choose plugin:context7:context7, and authenticate.

run: codex mcp list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 == "context7" { print $NF }' | grep -qx OAuth
checks.say: Codex is not signed in to Context7. Run codex mcp login context7.
Convex is not signed in on this machine. Run npx convex login once. Each project then picks its own deployment, and agents should never point at a production deployment by default.
